scope: Life index after the EC2 re-measurement of KMA-LIFE-DISTINCT (AK 2026-11-10, design revision 2 approved after two design reviews): while a process's first owned life read runs, no request starts a UV or pollen acquisition, raced or not. A guard held by that read's owned task ends this however the read ends (completed, failed, owner deadline, cancelled or panicked); waiter outcomes never do. Afterwards requests decide as before, and a later read that misses the head start races as before. MFDS, KASI, the life read and its publication check, the memo and the overlay are unchanged. No timer or budget is added. No deployment or production mutation.
